page0.text:
"..."
My body feels heavy.
I feel awful as I wake as I'm immediately assaulted by a headache.

page1.text:
"...I wonder if it's because of my injury from yesterday. My right arm still slightly hurts."
I mutter while getting up.
It's already past 6 AM.

page2.text:
"Crap, I should be making breakfast...!"
I jump out of bed and change quickly.
Fuji-nee and Sakura have morning practice.
They leave at 6:30 AM, so I won't make it unless I hurry.

page3.text:
After I see them off, I drink tea with Saber after breakfast.
The morning goes by in a whirlwind and before I know it, it's past 7 AM.

page4.text:
"I'm gonna get going. Take care while I'm gone, Saber."
"Yes. Please be careful yourself as well. Please do not do anything reckless just because you have Rin's help."
"Yeah, I learned from yesterday. I'll ask for your help if I go after an enemy."

page5.text:
I wave goodbye to Saber and leave.
The morning air is peaceful.
But the school that I'm about to head to is completely different.

page6.text:
"...All right."
I brace myself as I go down the hill.
Tohsaka is a right and proper Master. I need to step up, or I'll just make a fool of myself.

page7.text:
I greet my classmates as I get to my seat...
"...Huh?"
Along the way...
I make eye contact with an unexpected person, and I'm momentarily at a loss for words.

page8.text:
Are you serious?
It's instinctive.
I storm towards Shinji.
"Shinji, you...!"

page9.text:
"Hey, Emiya. What's going on? You're looking a little scary this morning. What, did something happen while I was gone?"
"Cut it out. What did you do to Mitsuzuri?"

page10.text:
"Mitsuzuri...? Oh, Ayako. It seems like she ran away from home. I heard about it this morning at the range, too. So she was found in Shinto, huh?"
None of this is funny, but Shinji laughs.
The look in his eyes tells me he's delighted by mocking Mitsuzuri.

page11.text: "...Don't play dumb. You're the last person who talked to her. I'm asking you what you did to her then."

page12.text:
"Huh? We only chatted for a bit.
More importantly, did you hear, Emiya!? They found her on the ground in a back alley. I heard she was all dizzy and her uniform was messed up.
Man, I don't know what happened, but you gotta be curious, right? About how that bitchy brat got trashed."

page13.text:
...
"Why the scary face? It's just a joke. Don't take it so seriously. Ayako's being looked after, right? I think she's resting at home. Well, I guess it'll be harder for her once she comes back, since the rumors will have spread by then."

page14.text:
"...Hey. Are you saying you told everyone in the kyudo club about this?"
"Maybe. But all the first years know about it already. It's not a telephone game, but I hear the rumor's been making it around."

page15.text:
...
I can feel my fists clenching, and clamp down on the urge I'm feeling.
Did he go around telling everyone such a story?
Mitsuzuri is a girl. Everyone knows she's strong, but even so.
Regardless of how strong she is, rumors like that have a way of eating away at anybody.

page16.text:
Did he go around telling everyone knowing that?
It's being kept from everybody for a reason, but he's deliberately spreading rumors to hurt her...!

page17.text:
"...Shinji, you...!"
I grab his shoulders.
"Don't glare at me like that. I said I don't know anything about it. Don't say something you'll regret, Emiya."
Shrugging out of my grip, Shinji goes to his seat.

page18.text:
The homeroom bell rings.
"Khh..."
I can't stay standing here.
With a glance at Shinji, I am forced to make my way back to my seat.
